subject: english
question: **Change the following from active to passive**: Editors deem such practices incompatible with editorial ethics.

options.text: Such practices are deemed incompatible with editorial ethics.
Editorial ethics deems such practices as incompatible.
Editors have deemed editorial ethics incompatible with such practices.
Editorial compatibility is deemed absent in such practices.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Editors deem such practices incompatible with editorial ethics."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "such practices" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "deem" to "are deemed" (present simple passive).
 
• Add the rest of the sentence "incompatible with editorial ethics" as it is.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"Such practices are deemed incompatible with editorial ethics."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"Editorial ethics deems such practices as incompatible." – This is in active voice, not passive.
 
• **Option 3: **"Editors have deemed editorial ethics incompatible with such practices." – This is in active voice and does not follow the passive structure.
 
• **Option 4: **"Editorial compatibility is deemed absent in such practices." – This alters the original meaning of the sentence.
